text: １ねんに　１ど　だけ　クチバこう　に　とまるんだ！

structure.jp: クチバこう　に　とまるんだ！
structure.en: it docks at Vermilion Harbor, you see!

patterns.name: 〜に (per)
patterns.explanation: に between a length of time and a number of times means 'per'. １ねんに　１ど = 'once a year'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ is the spoken form of のだ and gives the sentence an explaining tone, like 'you see'. とまるんだ = 'it docks, you see'.
